description: This file defines a React component 'Column' which represents a Kanban board column, managing inline editing, deletion, and rendering a list of cards. It connects to the Kanban context for state management and handles user interactions such as editing titles and deleting columns.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates the new column title, ensuring it is non-empty and different from the current title.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Initiates inline editing mode for the column title.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the new column title, with validation, and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles key events in the title input field, including Enter (save) and Escape (cancel).

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to show the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs deletion of the column and associated cleanup.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })

ctags.name: Column
ctags.pattern: /^function Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
